question: In which state is the Gorumara National Park located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gorumara National Park** is situated in the foothills of the **Eastern Himalayas** in the** Terai region** of **West Bengal.**
 
• It was declared a **National Park** in the year **1992** and is spread over an area of **80 sq km.**
 
• The park is famous for its **one-horned rhinoceros** and is also home to several other species of animals such as **elephants, leopards, gaurs,** and different types of deer.
 
• The park is also a paradise for **bird watchers **as it is home to over** 200 species **of birds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Assam **is home to the following national parks: **Rajiv Gandhi-Orang National Park, Kaziranga National Park, Manas National Park, Nameri National Park, Raimona National Park, and Dihing Patkai National Park.**
 
• The national parks of **Uttarakhand** are **Jim Corbett National Park, Rajaji National Park, and Gangotri National Park**.
 
• The** lone** tiger reserve in **Bihar** is the** Valmiki Tiger Reserve,** which represents the easternmost boundary of the Himalayan Terai forests in India.
